_comment: Rules the core itself declares for mechanism-guard (CONVENTIONS: a tool ships mechanism-rules.json at its root; the guard reads it from the enabled plugin). Each rule names the defined path in `instead`.

rules.was: a PR merge through the raw API (gh api -X PUT .../pulls/<n>/merge) - the usual way to re-issue a merge the permission layer refused for `gh pr merge`
rules.instead: A refused action is not re-issued in another form (rules/working-rules.md, Mechanism Discipline, 'A refusal is a decision'). Report what was refused and for what; the merge goes through `gh pr merge` once permitted, or through the party/operator who holds the right.

rules.was: waiting for CI in the foreground - a core CI run takes about 15 minutes and holds the whole session; several PRs in a row cost hours
rules.instead: Start the same command detached (Bash run_in_background, or Monitor) and keep working; the verdict arrives as a notification (Working Rule #9). Several PRs: one detached watch each, in parallel.
